additional_same_contract_changes.change: Use std::to_underlying for the Technology setter and comparison while retaining uintptr_t/intptr_t destinations.
additional_same_contract_changes.reason: The same enum conversion contract is used in Windows-only consumers outside the analyzed Linux variant.

false_positives.reason: SelfDrags is reached from DragApp::InitMainDrags. Its __WXMSW__ branch calls unqualified Win32 GetFocus() after activating the owned editor, to verify native keyboard focus. The pinned Scintilla::Message also defines GetFocus = 2381. Importing the enum in that function hides the Win32 function and causes a compile error. S6177 explicitly excludes name collisions and shadowing. The Linux analysis omits the Windows call.

compiler_control.diagnostic: Scintilla::Message::GetFocus cannot be used as a function
compiler_control.scope: C++ lookup proof with a global function declaration; this control is not a Windows SDK build.

source_review.method: Complete source reading and repository searches for enum definitions, callers and consumers, plus complete-file lexical comparisons. CodeGraph was not used.
source_review.imports: Each import stays in the reported existing function, loop, switch, lambda or other local block. Enum member sets were compared with original unqualified names, including platform branches.
source_review.conversions: Underlying enum types were checked. Existing integer widths, signedness, message parameters, index casts and bit operations are retained.
source_review.independent_review: Application edits and the second test group received independent source/diff review. The latter identified a conditional utility include, corrected before publication.
source_review.literal_preservation: Complete-file token/transform checks preserve existing string and character literal tokens, comments, fixture data, assertions and command order.
source_review.shared_helper_followup: The previously retained Unhex parameter and two generic oracle exceptions are addressed in this batch. Complete helper and caller review covers syntax_config_languages.cpp, syntax_native_languages.cpp and syntax_markdown.cpp; their translation units were recompiled after the header follow-up.

syntax_compilation.headers: Official wxWidgets v3.3.3 public headers (670835aec7e54b9e9d5a50d6a1aea1e8ba0bcdb2), GTK 3 development headers, prepared original core.

enum_controls.control_values: Underlying type minimum, zero, one and maximum across destination integer types.

occurrence_controls.boundaries: Includes counts around 2^53 and intptr_t maximum; floating results are compared by complete bit representation.

hosted.scope: Existing Windows, Linux X11/Wayland, coverage, clang-tidy, fuzz, CodeQL and SonarCloud workflows validate the combined published head.

retained_work.reason: These 20 drawing/window conversions need a consistent range, rounding and clipping decision and native rendering regression checks.
PolyLine has dynamic Indicator callers; the fixed Polygon 12-point bound does not establish a safe int bound for this count.

The supported bounded-escape recommendation applies to a frozen 497834-byte compressed stream. A representation change needs coordinated generator/data validation; rewriting each escape adds 995668 source bytes.
Recovery and test-result boundaries retain their previously reviewed exception contracts. The rule exceptions do not establish a false-positive classification.
The framework inheritance-depth design recommendation retains its existing review status.
